gloss: rowing by hand; oar-powered; manually rowed/paddled

definitions.gloss: rowing by hand; powered by hand-operated oars (as opposed to a motor)
definitions.explanation: Used as a noun and as a noun-modifier (with の) to describe boats, vehicles, or simple machines that are propelled by human muscle power — typically by oars or paddles — rather than by an engine or motor. Most often heard in {手漕|てこ}ぎボート ("rowboat").

examples.japanese: {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: We rented a rowboat at the lake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、{手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舟|ふね}→舟：23868_fune⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{漁|りょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ていた→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather used to go out fishing every day in a hand-rowed boat.

examples.japanese: ⟦モーターボート→モーターボート：27294_mootaabooto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧、{手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{湖面|こめん}→湖面：27150_komen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Unlike motorboats, rowboats glide quietly across the lake's surface, so you can really enjoy nature.

notes:
{手漕|てこ}ぎ is the noun form of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧ (literally "to row by hand"), used to describe vehicles or boats propelled by human-powered oars or paddles. It is overwhelmingly used as a modifier of another noun (especially {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧), with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ as the connector.

FORMS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ ("hand") + ⟦{漕|こ}ぎ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧ (the noun form of ⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧ "to row, to paddle")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧: rowboat (the most frequent use)
- {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧ / {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舟|ふね}→舟：23868_fune⟧: a hand-rowed boat
- {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧: hand-operated pump
- {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance by rowing (by hand)

SIMILAR / CONTRASTING TERMS:
- {足漕|あしこ}ぎ: pedal-powered (e.g. {足漕|あしこ}ぎ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧ "pedal boat")
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧: electric-powered (the modern contrast)
- ⟦モーター→モーター：23127_mootaa⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: motor-equipped
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧: automatic / self-propelled

USAGE:
- Although {手漕|てこ}ぎ technically can describe other hand-cranked devices (e.g. an old hand pump), in everyday Japanese it almost always refers to boats. Outside that context, native speakers more often spell out {手|て}{動|どう} ("manual") or ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧ as a verb phrase.
- When attached to another noun, the connector is ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {手漕|てこ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧, not {手漕|てこ}ぎ{船|ぶね}.
